argv:
set -eu; ln -s /opt/cargo/registry /cargo-home/registry; printf "RUSTUP_ACTIVE=%s
" "$RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN"; printf "RUSTC_PATH=%s
" "$(command -v rustc)"; printf "CARGO_PATH=%s
" "$(command -v cargo)"; printf "RUSTC_RESOLVED=%s
" "$(rustup which rustc)"; printf "CARGO_RESOLVED=%s
" "$(rustup which cargo)"; printf "BUN_PATH=%s
" "$(command -v bun)"; printf "NODE_PATH=%s
" "$(command -v node)"; printf "PYTHON_PATH=%s
" "$(command -v python3)"; printf "RUSTC_VERSION=%s
" "$(rustc --version)"; printf "CARGO_VERSION=%s
" "$(cargo --version)"; RUSTC_HOST="$(rustc -vV | awk '$1 == "host:" {print $2}')"; test "$RUSTC_HOST" = "x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu"; printf "RUSTC_HOST=%s
" "$RUSTC_HOST"; printf "BUN_VERSION=%s
" "$(bun --version)"; printf "NODE_VERSION=%s
" "$(node --version)"; printf "PYTHON_VERSION=%s
" "$(python3 --version)"; test -d /opt/cargo/registry; test -f /workspace/node_modules/ajv/package.json; test -f /workspace/node_modules/playwright/package.json; test -f /workspace/node_modules/typescript/package.json; test -f /workspace/node_modules/yaml/package.json

runtime.pythonQualification: 3.11.17 explicit replacement for requested 3.12; narrower evidence

scope: bounded source/package guards only; no product Rust suite, native/compiler/wheel/browser/Mac campaign, full conformance workflow, or publication

source.transientControls: only listed scope guards may create and remove source control files; exact path/mode/content inventory is compared after the owned container is confirmed absent; temporary empty node_modules mountpoint is removed before postinventory
